walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE English Literature specification.

Unit 1: The Study of Prose appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Unit 1: The Study of Prose in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 1: The Study of Prose.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
